description: This file contains integration tests for a FastAPI-based CSV conversion service, validating endpoints such as health check, file conversion via path, upload handling, validation errors, and temporary file cleanup.

methods.name: list[list[str]] _parse_csv_rows(text: str)
methods.description: Parses CSV text into a list of rows, splitting on commas, assuming simple CSV format without quotes.

methods.name: None test_health_check(api_client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the health check endpoint for status and message.

methods.name: None test_convert_by_path_success( tmp_path: Path, api_client: TestClient, lpt_bin_bytes_valid_two_records: bytes )
methods.description: Validates successful conversion via file paths, checking response, output file creation, and CSV content.

methods.name: None test_convert_by_path_validation_error_empty_path(api_client: TestClient)
methods.description: Ensures validation error when input path is empty.

methods.name: None test_convert_by_path_outside_allowed_root_is_400( tmp_path: Path, api_client: TestClient )
methods.description: Checks that paths outside the allowed root return a 400 error.

methods.name: None test_convert_by_path_not_found_is_400_due_to_validation( api_client: TestClient, tmp_path: Path )
methods.description: Validates that non-existent input files trigger a validation error.

methods.name: None test_convert_upload_success_and_temp_cleanup( tmp_path: Path, api_client: TestClient, lpt_bin_bytes_valid_two_records: bytes, temp_dir_file_snapshot, )
methods.description: Tests file upload conversion, response correctness, and cleanup of temporary files.

methods.name: None test_convert_upload_missing_file_field_returns_422(api_client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks validation when the 'file' multipart field is missing.

methods.name: None test_convert_upload_malformed_bin_returns_400_and_cleans_temps( tmp_path: Path, api_client: TestClient, temp_dir_file_snapshot, )
methods.description: Verifies behavior with malformed binary uploads, ensuring proper response and cleanup.
